label: Contact page archetype
reference_archetype: Generic practice contact page with a multi-scope opening-hours table.
reference_url_note: Register row S1 structural reference only; content 100% invented.
edge_cases: Multi-scope hours table: clinic hours ≠ pathology collection hours ≠ reception hours; must never be compared as one field (DECISION_LOG D11).
External booking link (example booking service) is present but must NOT be collected as practice website.
After-hours note is a phone service, not clinic opening hours (scope trap).
synthesis_rationale: Primary scope-classification and business-contact-rule edge case page; hours per scope plus contact fields plus one off-scope external link.
